title: Edit category and priority
purpose: Change a ticket's category or priority, with an optional reason.
summary: Correct the ticket's category or priority. It does not move the ticket to the new category's team, and moving it into a complaint category makes it a complaint.

tasks.title: Change the priority
steps: Choose the new value in [[Priority]], add a [[Reason (optional)]] if useful and select [[Save changes]].

tasks.title: Correct the category
steps: Choose the right entry in [[Category]], then select [[Save changes]].

good_to_know: Changing the category does not change the team or assignee. Use Assign to move the ticket.
A complaint category makes the ticket a complaint. Moving it out of one does not unmark it; a supervisor does that.
Save is refused unless the category or priority really changes.
A closed ticket cannot change, so this form is not offered for it.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: Opens from the More menu of the ticket page, as a dialog or a full page. Any active staff role who may read the ticket may use it. The form remembers the version of the ticket you opened; if it changed since, saving is refused and you reload.

items.label: Category
items.description: Required. Active categories under their group; a group cannot be chosen. It starts on the current category.

items.label: Priority
items.description: Required: Low, Normal, High or Urgent. It starts on the current priority.

items.label: Reason (optional)
items.description: Why it changed. Kept with the change in the audit history.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Saves, confirms Details changed and adds a timeline event naming what changed (priority, category). Choosing both unchanged is refused ("Change the priority or the category before saving.").

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the ticket without changing anything.

items.label: Complaint categories
items.description: Choosing a category flagged as a complaint category marks the ticket as a complaint and records that on the timeline (by its category). Choosing a category that is not one never unmarks a complaint.

items.label: Restricted categories
items.description: Who may read a restricted ticket depends on team membership. Moving a ticket into a restricted category can hide it from you if you are not in its team and are not a supervisor.

items.label: Service clocks
items.description: When service targets are configured, the clock targets are worked out again when category or priority changes. This page sets no targets.
